# C2PA conformance program — generator-product topics: clause → mechanism → status

This table maps clauses to SecuraCV mechanisms. It is not a determination: the C2PA conformance program, and each relying party's validator configuration decides whether a deployment's records and controls are acceptable. The receipt ledgers are the record; this table points at them. Status words: [STATUS.md](STATUS.md). The frame: [README.md](README.md).
